allowed_bind_receipt.address: Exact repr of supplied address, with exact family/type/protocol recorded.
allowed_bind_receipt.counter: Increment Python_literal_loopback_binds_allowed before attempting an admitted bind. Keep this counter and allowed event list separate from Python_network_operations_attempted and forbidden violations.
allowed_bind_receipt.event: Only the verified Python wrapper may admit socket.bind and suppress its matching underlying audit event. An unverified direct audit bind remains fatal.
allowed_bind_receipt.not_network_permission: Local bind permits no connect, listen, accept, DNS, send or receive operation, including loopback peers.
allowed_bind_receipt.outcome: PENDING event before the actual bind; terminal SUCCESS or ERROR event after actual bind. For ERROR retain exception type and available errno. Outcome must be complete in final raw audit.
allowed_bind_receipt.progress: Record both admission and outcome through the durable worker progress callback.
allowed_bind_receipt.stack: Nonempty source stack recorded at bind admission.

exact_allowed_bind_shapes.AF_INET: type(address) is tuple, len(address)==2, type(host) is str, host=='127.0.0.1', type(port) is int,0<=port<=65535
AF_INET6: type(address) is tuple, len(address)==2, type(host) is str, host=='::1', type(port) is int,0<=port<=65535
type(address) is tuple, len(address)==4, type(host) is str, host=='::1', type(port) is int,0<=port<=65535, type(flowinfo) is int and flowinfo==0, type(scopeid) is int and scopeid==0
exact_allowed_bind_shapes.IPv6_implicit_flowinfo_scopeid: The standard AF_INET6(host,port) tuple uses implicit0/0; an explicit four-tuple requires exact builtin int0 values.
exact_allowed_bind_shapes.host: Exact literal builtin string only. No hostnames, whitespace, IPv4 aliases, other127/8addresses, wildcards, zone identifiers, IPv4-mapped IPv6 or nonloopback addresses.
exact_allowed_bind_shapes.port: Exact builtin int, never bool, inclusive range0..65535.
exact_allowed_bind_shapes.rejected_types: bool is not int for this policy. String subclasses, equality-overriding host objects, tuple subclasses and non-tuples are rejected.

Node: all callback and promise DNS/name resolution entrypoints
all bind operations; no Node bind exception is admitted
forbidden_operations.counts: Python_network_operations_attempted and Node_network_operations_attempted must both equal0 for qualification; allowed Python literal-local bind attempts do not increment them.
forbidden_operations.persistent_rule: Increment the corresponding forbidden-operation counter and append an event with address and stack BEFORE raising. A caught exception cannot clear the violations or counter. Any nonzero forbidden operation or persistent violation rejects the worker and epoch qualification; no posthoc waiver.
forbidden_operations.scope: Instrumented Python/Node API guards plus reviewed offline-only candidate/native helper code. This is not OS-enforced syscall/network sandbox isolation.

prior_policy_resolution: Existing restored epoch26 v2 canonical file is a dependency reference, not duplicated or modified for epoch27. This new epoch27 v3 document states the complete policy.
reason: Retain the prospectively authorized noncommunicating literal-loopback bind exception, including standard Python IPv6 two-tuple form, and require host to be an exact builtin str before equality to its literal.
required_prelaunch_and_final_checks: Freeze this exact new v3 policy and exact Python/Node guard source identities before worker admission
Independent pure validation of valid literal shapes, rejection of hostname/alias/type/flow/scope variants and persistent caught-violation behavior
Preserve every actual bind admission/outcome and every attempted forbidden operation in raw/progress outputs
Reject incomplete/PENDING bind receipts, unverified allowed addresses, counter/event mismatch or any forbidden attempt
Keep all current epoch25/epoch26 source and policy artifacts unchanged and all previous attempts closed
